description:
Activate Millikin by tapping it and milling a card, adding {C}.
Activate Junktroller by tapping it, putting any card from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
When the Spirits enter, Intruder Alarm triggers twice, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
